gc.story.1.text: Deep under Monster Island, Gloop's crystal cave went dark.

gc.story.2.text: The crystals only glow when someone hops the right number of spaces.

gc.story.3.text: Then Zuzu bounced in with her little lantern. Hello, Gloop!

gc.story.4.text: Let's help Gloop hop along the track, one space at a time!

gc.story.mid1.text: Look! The crystals are waking up. The cave is getting brighter!

gc.story.mid2.text: Halfway there! Gloop can see the sparkly walls again.

gc.story.mid3.text: Just a few more hops, and the whole cave will shine!

gc.story.end1.text: Wow! The whole crystal cave is sparkling again!

gc.story.end2.text: Gloop is doing a wiggly jelly dance! You counted every hop.

gc.story.end3.text: You found a Brain Spark! Next time, the tunnels go even deeper.

gc.help.explain.text: Each hop is plus one! Start on the first number, then count every hop.

gc.help.hint.text: Let's go back to the start. Say the next number on every hop!

gc.praise.1.text: You hopped all the way to {n}!

gc.praise.2.text: Hop by hop, you counted on to {n}!

gc.praise.3.text: The crystals glow! You landed right on {n}!

gc.hint.countAlong.text: Let's count the hops together. Plus one, plus one!

gc.hint.model.text: Watch the hops. Each hop lands on the next number.

gc.hint.modelTap.text: We land on {n}! Move the cart to {n}, then press Go.

gc.idle.text: Slide the cart, or tap Hop. Each hop moves one space!
